_about: John Eyton Bickersteth Mayor (1825-1910), Kennedy Professor of Latin at Cambridge: Thirteen Satires of Juvenal with a commentary, fourth edition revised (London and New York: Macmillan, vol. I 1886, vol. II 1888), the great English commentary on Juvenal, raw IA. Latin text with English commentary dense with Latin and Greek citations, so the English-word ratio of the OCR is low (0.73, 0.78) though the text reads; kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling on text-facing editions. His brother Joseph B. Mayor has the j-b-mayor shelf; his Early English Text Society edition of John Fisher sits with lane A.
